scope: Standalone serialized single-output API34+ P010/HLG capture source, not ULike integration or phone execution
static_review: Single-output source requires exclusive borrowed camera ownership and documents replacing previous session
Physical route membership plus capabilities, exact-size budget and exact session support are checked
Output sensor timestamps and no readout timestamp request are explicit; submitted request object and actual sensor timestamps must match
All public lifecycle and callbacks serialize on the selected Handler
Pair closes Image after copying owned P010 samples; failure/cancel/timeout closes retained ownership
Actual color/range and image crop verified by hdr_input; no JPEG/NV21 fallback
Applied no-rotation/mirror separated from intended display rotation in immutable provenance
Cleanup individually attempts listener removal, session close and reader close, preserving cleanup exceptions as suppressed; final changed source recompiled successfully
limits: Android framework was compiled against SDK36, not executed on a device
No 3A convergence, preview, focus-speed optimization, all-mode support, lens-switch timing or ULike hook
Timeout cancels software pairing; it does not prove hardware abortion or bounded HAL call latency
Late prior Images can cause a current shot rejection, but cannot pass unequal sensor timestamp validation
Stock bytecode observations in STOCK_BOUNDARY_AUDIT are author evidence, not independently re-disassembled in this review
Native sensor resolution and image color behavior need actual capture evidence
